blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Former Senator Antonio Trillanes IV arrived at the Senate on Tuesday to observe the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte. The former legislator is also listed among the prosecution’s witnesses for Duterte’s alleged unexplained wealth. Trillanes appeared to be with the House prosecution panel and was seen walking alongside private prosecutor Atty. Lorna Kapunan. Asked if he would take the witness stand, Trillanes told reporters, “I hope so.” READ: LIVE UPDATES: Sara Duterte impeachment trial | Sept. 29, 2026 Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte, meanwhile, is the witness scheduled to testify on Tuesday.
